mapper.sql: select f.fee_id, f.activity_id, f.guest_id, f.fee_amount, f.progress_status, f.pay_status, f.bank_name, f.bank_account, f.del_flag, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, g.guest_name, g.phone as guest_phone from yc_guest_fee f left join yc_guest g on g.guest_id=f.guest_id and g.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, ifnull(sum(case when pay_status='1' then 1 else 0 end),0) as paidCount, ifnull(sum(case when pay_status='0' then 1 else 0 end),0) as unpaidCount, ifnull(sum(fee_amount),0) as totalAmount from yc_guest_fee where activity_id=#{activityId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: update yc_guest_fee set del_flag='2' where fee_id in #{id}
